key_insights: Peak hours (7-9 AM, 6-9 PM) account for 52.2% of total daily demand; replenishment attention should prioritize these periods.
Weekend demand is 23.1% higher per day than weekday demand; replenishment schedules should account for this weekend surge.
Fruits & Vegetables is the highest-demand category with 34,046 units; high-velocity categories should receive greater forecasting priority.
The Random Forest model achieves R² = 0.3710 and MAE = 1.3322 units using strictly leakage-safe features.
Top predictive features: Product_Hist_Avg_Demand, Category_Hist_Avg_Demand, Store_Orders_Roll_Mean_7d, Day_of_Week, Demand_Roll_Std_7d
